evals.prompt: Convert ./samples/report.pdf to Markdown and save it in ./converted.
evals.expected_output: Runs the bundled conversion script with the local PDF path and --output-dir ./converted, then reports the generated Markdown path and verifies it is non-empty.

evals.prompt: I have a folder of docx and pptx files. Batch convert them to markdown files for an LLM index.
evals.expected_output: Uses scripts/convert_to_markdown.py with multiple local Office file inputs and an output directory, not one manual command per file unless globbing is unavailable.

evals.prompt: Turn this public webpage into markdown: https://example.com/page.html
evals.expected_output: Uses --allow-remote with the helper script, preserving remote safety checks; does not call a broad URL converter without validation.

evals.prompt: This scanned PDF is coming out blank. Use Azure Document Intelligence with my endpoint to extract it.
evals.expected_output: Uses --docintel-endpoint after confirming the endpoint/credentials are available and notes that the document will be sent to Azure.

evals.prompt: Use the installed MarkItDown OCR plugin on this file.
evals.expected_output: Checks or uses plugin mode explicitly with --use-plugins; does not enable plugins by default for unrelated conversions.

evals.prompt: Convert ./samples/report.pdf with image descriptions using gpt-4o-mini, but I have not configured any OpenAI credentials. Return a JSON summary of what happened.
evals.expected_output: Runs the helper with --llm-model and --json, reports a clear configuration error about missing OpenAI-compatible credentials without a Python traceback, preserves JSON-formatted failure output, and exits as a configuration failure rather than attempting conversion.
